evidence.observation: Growth pressure 3.055 Torr and exhaust oxygen 5.2 ppm, near the preceding stable baseline.
Pressure rose to 3.110 Torr and oxygen to 11.8 ppm.

Pressure rose further to 3.196 Torr and oxygen to 19.0 ppm despite stable argon flow of 99.8 sccm and temperature of 750.4 °C at 100 sccm and 750 °C setpoints; this suggests an atmosphere-control fault, potentially air ingress.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-integrity check and exhaust-path/pumping verification are needed to distinguish a seal leak from other pressure/oxygen disturbances; sample characterization is not yet available.
